# Android SDK API 参考 (/docs/android-sdk/api-reference)



# API 参考 [#api-参考]

## IVCSdk [#ivcsdk]

SDK 主入口类。

### 初始化 [#初始化]

```kotlin
IVCSdk.init(context: Context, config: SDKConfig)
```

### 登录 [#登录]

```kotlin
IVCSdk.auth().login(phone: String): Result<UserSession>
```

## VehicleManager [#vehiclemanager]

### 获取车辆列表 [#获取车辆列表]

```kotlin
IVCSdk.vehicle().getVehicles(): Flow<List<Vehicle>>
```

### 远程控制 [#远程控制]

```kotlin
IVCSdk.control().lock(vehicleId: String): Flow<ControlResult>
IVCSdk.control().unlock(vehicleId: String): Flow<ControlResult>
```


# 安卓 SDK 总览 (/docs/android-sdk)





# 安卓 SDK 总览 [#安卓-sdk-总览]

<Callout type="info">
  最低 SDK 版本: API 26 (Android 8.0)\
  编译 SDK 版本: API 35 (Android 15)\
  包名: `com.ivc.sdk`
</Callout>

## 集成方式 [#集成方式]

### Gradle 依赖 [#gradle-依赖]

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation("com.ivc.sdk:ivc-sdk:2.1.0")
}
```

### 权限配置 [#权限配置]

```xml
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT" />
```

## SDK 架构 [#sdk-架构]

<Mermaid
  chart="flowchart LR
    SDK[IVC SDK] --> Auth[认证模块]
    SDK --> Vehicle[车辆模块]
    SDK --> Control[控制模块]
    SDK --> Nav[导航模块]
    Auth --> API[云端 API]
    Vehicle --> API
    Control --> MQ[MQTT]
    Nav --> API"
/>


# Android SDK 快速开始 (/docs/android-sdk/quickstart)





# 快速开始 [#快速开始]

## 初始化 SDK [#初始化-sdk]

<Steps>
  <Step title="添加依赖">
    在 `build.gradle.kts` 中添加 SDK 依赖。
  </Step>

  <Step title="初始化">
    ```kotlin
    class MyApplication : Application() {
        override fun onCreate() {
            super.onCreate()
            IVCSdk.init(
                context = this,
                config = SDKConfig(
                    clientId = "your_client_id",
                    environment = Environment.STAGING
                )
            )
        }
    }
    ```
  </Step>

  <Step title="登录">
    ```kotlin
    lifecycleScope.launch {
        val result = IVCSdk.auth().login(phone = "13800138000")
        when (result) {
            is Result.Success -> {
                // 登录成功
            }
            is Result.Error -> {
                // 处理错误
            }
        }
    }
    ```
  </Step>
</Steps>


# 数据流设计 (/docs/architecture/data-flow)





# 数据流设计 [#数据流设计]

## 核心数据流 [#核心数据流]

### 车辆状态上报 [#车辆状态上报]

<Mermaid
  chart="flowchart LR
    VC[车机 CAN Bus] -->|采集| DAU[数据采集单元]
    DAU -->|MQTT| MQ[消息队列]
    MQ -->|消费| SP[流处理]
    SP -->|写入| TS[(时序数据库)]
    TS -->|查询| API[REST API]
    API -->|WebSocket| APP[移动 App]"
/>

## 数据结构 [#数据结构]

<Callout type="info">
  所有时间戳统一使用 UTC 时间，毫秒精度。
</Callout>

### VehicleStatus [#vehiclestatus]

| 字段             | 类型       | 说明            |
| -------------- | -------- | ------------- |
| vehicle\_id    | string   | 车辆 VIN 码      |
| timestamp      | int64    | 数据采集时间戳       |
| battery\_level | float    | 电量百分比 (0-100) |
| speed          | float    | 速度 (km/h)     |
| location       | GeoPoint | GPS 坐标        |
| engine\_status | enum     | 引擎状态          |


# 架构总览 (/docs/architecture)





# 架构总览 [#架构总览]

<Callout type="info">
  本文档描述智能车联系统的整体架构设计。
</Callout>

## 系统分层 [#系统分层]

<Mermaid
  chart="graph TD
    A[移动端 App] --> B[API Gateway]
    B --> C[微服务集群]
    C --> D[(数据库)]
    C --> E[消息队列]
    E --> F[车机端]
    B --> G[第三方服务]"
/>

## 技术架构 [#技术架构]

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="app" title="移动端">
    * 架构: MVVM + Clean Architecture
    * 网络: Retrofit / URLSession
    * 状态管理: StateFlow / Combine
    * 本地存储: Room / CoreData
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="backend" title="后端">
    * 框架: Spring Boot / Go
    * API 协议: REST + gRPC
    * 数据库: PostgreSQL + Redis
    * 消息队列: Kafka
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="vehicle" title="车机端">
    * 系统: Android Automotive / Linux
    * 通信: MQTT + CAN Bus
    * OTA: AB 分区升级
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

    <Folder name="app">
      <File name="presentation" />

      <File name="data" />
    </Folder>

    <Folder name="shared">
      <File name="network" />

      <File name="storage" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>


# 系统概述 (/docs/architecture/system-overview)



# 系统概述 [#系统概述]

## 系统边界 [#系统边界]

智能车联系统包含以下核心子系统：

1. **云端平台** — 核心业务逻辑与数据存储
2. **移动 App** — 用户交互界面
3. **车机系统** — 车辆数据采集与控制执行
4. **管理后台** — 运维与数据分析

## 通信架构 [#通信架构]

<Mermaid
  chart="sequenceDiagram
    participant App as 移动 App
    participant GW as API Gateway
    participant MS as 微服务
    participant MQ as 消息队列
    participant VC as 车机

    App->>GW: HTTPS/WSS 请求
    GW->>MS: 路由转发
    MS->>MQ: 推送指令
    MQ->>VC: MQTT 推送
    VC-->>MQ: 执行结果
    MQ-->>MS: 消息回调
    MS-->>GW: 响应
    GW-->>App: 请求结果"
/>

## 部署架构 [#部署架构]

| 组件          | 部署方式       | 规格       |
| ----------- | ---------- | -------- |
| API Gateway | K8s (多副本)  | 4C8G x 3 |
| 微服务         | K8s (弹性伸缩) | 2C4G x 5 |
| PostgreSQL  | 云 RDS      | 主从架构     |
| Redis       | 云 Redis    | 集群模式     |
| Kafka       | 云 Kafka    | 3 Broker |


# 认证机制 (/docs/cloud-api/authentication)





# 认证机制 [#认证机制]

## OAuth 2.0 流程 [#oauth-20-流程]

<Mermaid
  chart="sequenceDiagram
    participant App as 移动 App
    participant Auth as 认证服务
    participant API as API Gateway

    App->>Auth: 1. 授权请求 (client_id + scope)
    Auth->>Auth: 2. 用户认证
    Auth-->>App: 3. 授权码
    App->>Auth: 4. 换取 Token
    Auth-->>App: 5. Access Token + Refresh Token
    App->>API: 6. API 请求 (Bearer Token)
    API->>Auth: 7. Token 验证
    Auth-->>API: 8. 用户信息
    API-->>App: 9. 响应"
/>

## Token 格式 [#token-格式]

使用 JWT (JSON Web Token)，包含以下声明：

```json
{
  "sub": "user_123456",
  "aud": "ivc-system",
  "exp": 1719000000,
  "iat": 1718913600,
  "scope": "vehicle:read vehicle:write"
}
```

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="header" title="请求头">
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="error" title="错误响应">
    ```json
    {
      "error": "UNAUTHORIZED",
      "message": "Token 已过期",
      "status": 401
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>


# API 端点 (/docs/cloud-api/endpoints)



# API 端点 [#api-端点]

## 车辆状态 [#车辆状态]

### 获取车辆列表 [#获取车辆列表]

`GET /vehicles`

**请求参数：**

| 参数     | 类型     | 必填 | 说明                   |
| ------ | ------ | -- | -------------------- |
| page   | int    | 否  | 页码，默认 1              |
| limit  | int    | 否  | 每页条数，默认 20           |
| status | string | 否  | 筛选状态: online/offline |

**响应示例：**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "v_001",
      "vin": "LSVAU2A38N2100001",
      "plate": "粤B·88888",
      "status": "online",
      "last_updated": "2026-07-26T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 20
}
```

### 获取车辆状态 [#获取车辆状态]

`GET /vehicles/{id}/status`

**响应示例：**

```json
{
  "vehicle_id": "v_001",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-26T10:00:00Z",
  "battery": {
    "level": 85.5,
    "charging": true
  },
  "location": {
    "latitude": 22.5431,
    "longitude": 114.0579
  },
  "speed": 0,
  "engine": "off"
}
```


# 云端 API 总览 (/docs/cloud-api)





# 云端 API 总览 [#云端-api-总览]

<Callout type="info">
  所有 API 均需通过 Bearer Token 认证。
  基础 URL: `https://api.ivc-system.com/v1`
</Callout>

## API 列表 [#api-列表]

### 车辆管理 [#车辆管理]

| 方法     | 路径                      | 说明     |
| ------ | ----------------------- | ------ |
| GET    | `/vehicles`             | 获取车辆列表 |
| POST   | `/vehicles/bind`        | 绑定车辆   |
| DELETE | `/vehicles/{id}`        | 解绑车辆   |
| GET    | `/vehicles/{id}/status` | 获取车辆状态 |

### 远程控制 [#远程控制]

| 方法   | 路径                       | 说明   |
| ---- | ------------------------ | ---- |
| POST | `/vehicles/{id}/lock`    | 远程锁车 |
| POST | `/vehicles/{id}/unlock`  | 远程解锁 |
| POST | `/vehicles/{id}/climate` | 空调控制 |

## 错误码 [#错误码]

| 状态码 | 错误码           | 说明    |
| --- | ------------- | ----- |
| 401 | UNAUTHORIZED  | 认证失败  |
| 403 | FORBIDDEN     | 无权限   |
| 404 | NOT\_FOUND    | 资源不存在 |
| 429 | RATE\_LIMITED | 请求限流  |


# 功能规格说明 (/docs/frs)



# 功能规格说明 [#功能规格说明]

## 功能列表 [#功能列表]

| 模块   | 功能点        | 优先级 |
| ---- | ---------- | --- |
| 用户管理 | 注册、登录、权限管理 | P0  |
| 车辆管理 | 绑定、解绑、状态查询 | P0  |
| 远程控制 | 锁车、空调、充电   | P1  |
| 导航服务 | 路线规划、实时路况  | P1  |
| 数据统计 | 里程、能耗、驾驶行为 | P2  |


# 接口定义 (/docs/frs/interface-def)





# 接口定义 [#接口定义]

## 内部接口 [#内部接口]

### App → 云端 [#app--云端]

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="rest" title="REST API">
    协议: HTTPS\
    格式: JSON\
    认证: Bearer Token\
    基础 URL: `https://api.ivc-system.com/v1`
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="ws" title="WebSocket">
    协议: WSS\
    用途: 实时状态推送\
    心跳: 30 秒\
    重连: 指数退避
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

### 云端 → 车机 [#云端--车机]

| 协议   | 用途   | QoS   |
| ---- | ---- | ----- |
| MQTT | 指令下发 | QoS 1 |
| MQTT | 状态上报 | QoS 0 |

## 接口规范 [#接口规范]

### 通用响应格式 [#通用响应格式]

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "success",
  "data": {},
  "request_id": "req_xxxxx"
}
```

### 分页参数 [#分页参数]

| 参数    | 类型     | 默认值 | 说明   |
| ----- | ------ | --- | ---- |
| page  | int    | 1   | 页码   |
| limit | int    | 20  | 每页条数 |
| sort  | string | -   | 排序字段 |
| order | string | asc | 排序方向 |


# 模块列表 (/docs/frs/module-list)





# 模块列表 [#模块列表]

## 核心模块 [#核心模块]

### 用户管理模块 [#用户管理模块]

| 功能   | 输入           | 输出           |
| ---- | ------------ | ------------ |
| 注册   | 手机号、验证码      | 用户 ID        |
| 登录   | 手机号+密码 / 验证码 | Access Token |
| 权限管理 | 用户 ID、角色     | 权限配置         |

### 车辆管理模块 [#车辆管理模块]

| 功能   | 输入          | 输出     |
| ---- | ----------- | ------ |
| 绑定车辆 | VIN 码、车主授权码 | 绑定记录   |
| 解绑车辆 | 车辆 ID       | 解绑确认   |
| 状态查询 | 车辆 ID       | 实时状态数据 |

### 远程控制模块 [#远程控制模块]

* 锁车/解锁
* 空调开关及温度设置
* 充电管理（开始/停止/预约）
* 车窗控制
* 寻车功能


# 鸿蒙 SDK API 参考 (/docs/harmony-sdk/api-reference)



# API 参考 [#api-参考]

## IVCSDK [#ivcsdk]

```typescript
interface IVCSDK {
  static init(config: SDKConfig): void;
  static auth(): AuthManager;
  static vehicle(): VehicleManager;
  static control(): ControlManager;
}
```

## AuthManager [#authmanager]

```typescript
interface AuthManager {
  login(phone: string): Promise<Result<UserSession>>;
  logout(): Promise<void>;
}
```

## VehicleManager [#vehiclemanager]

```typescript
interface VehicleManager {
  getVehicles(): Observable<Vehicle[]>;
  bind(vin: string): Promise<Vehicle>;
}
```

## ControlManager [#controlmanager]

```typescript
interface ControlManager {
  lock(vehicleId: string): Observable<ControlResult>;
  unlock(vehicleId: string): Observable<ControlResult>;
}
```

```typescript
import { IVCSDK, Environment } from '@ivc/sdk';

IVCSDK.init({
```

# 鸿蒙 SDK 快速开始 (/docs/harmony-sdk/quickstart)



# 快速开始 [#快速开始]

## 1. 安装 [#1-安装]

```bash
ohpm install @ivc/sdk
```

## 2. 初始化 [#2-初始化]

```typescript
// entry/src/main/ets/entryability/EntryAbility.ets
import { IVCSDK, Environment } from '@ivc/sdk';

export default class EntryAbility extends UIAbility {
  onCreate() {
    IVCSDK.init({
      clientId: 'your_client_id',
      environment: Environment.STAGING,
    });
  }
}
```

## 3. 登录 [#3-登录]

```typescript
import { IVCSDK } from '@ivc/sdk';

async function login() {
  const result = await IVCSDK.auth().login('13800138000');
  if (result.isSuccess) {
    console.info('登录成功');
  }
}
```


# iOS SDK API 参考 (/docs/ios-sdk/api-reference)



# API 参考 [#api-参考]

## IVCSDK [#ivcsdk]

```swift
class IVCSDK {
    static func configure(clientId: String, environment: Environment)
    static func auth() -> AuthManager
    static func vehicle() -> VehicleManager
    static func control() -> ControlManager
}
```

## AuthManager [#authmanager]

```swift
class AuthManager {
    func login(phone: String) async throws -> Result<UserSession, IVCError>
    func logout() async throws
    func refreshToken() async throws
}
```

## VehicleManager [#vehiclemanager]

```swift
class VehicleManager {
    func getVehicles() -> AsyncThrowingStream<[Vehicle], Error>
    func bind(vin: String) async throws -> Vehicle
    func unbind(vehicleId: String) async throws
}
```

## ControlManager [#controlmanager]

```swift
class ControlManager {
    func lock(vehicleId: String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<ControlResult, Error>
    func unlock(vehicleId: String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<ControlResult, Error>
    func setClimate(vehicleId: String, temperature: Double) -> AsyncThrowingStream<ControlResult, Error>
}
```

# iOS SDK 总览 [#ios-sdk-总览]

<Callout type="info">
  最低部署目标: iOS 15.0\
  Swift 版本: 5.9+\
  包名: `IVCSDK`
</Callout>

## 集成方式 [#集成方式]

```
https://github.com/ivc-system/ios-sdk.git
```

### CocoaPods [#cocoapods]

```ruby
pod 'IVCSDK', '~> 2.1.0'
```

## 初始化 [#初始化]

```swift
import IVCSDK

// AppDelegate.swift
IVCSDK.configure(
    clientId: "your_client_id",
    environment: .staging
)
```


# iOS SDK 快速开始 (/docs/ios-sdk/quickstart)



# 快速开始 [#快速开始]

## 1. 安装 SDK [#1-安装-sdk]

通过 Swift Package Manager 或 CocoaPods 安装。

## 2. 初始化 [#2-初始化]

```swift
// AppDelegate.swift
import IVCSDK

@main
class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    func application(_: UIApplication, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions _: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool {
        IVCSDK.configure(clientId: "your_client_id", environment: .staging)
        return true
    }
}
```

## 3. 登录 [#3-登录]

```swift
Task {
    let result = try await IVCSDK.auth().login(phone: "13800138000")
    switch result {
    case .success(let session):
        print("登录成功: \(session.userId)")
    case .failure(let error):
        print("登录失败: \(error.localizedDescription)")
    }
}
```

# API 参考 [#api-参考]

```typescript
interface IVCSDK {
  static init(config: WechatSDKConfig): void;
  static auth(): AuthManager;
  static vehicle(): VehicleManager;
}
```

```typescript
interface AuthManager {
  loginWithPhone(encryptedData: string, iv: string): Promise<UserSession>;
  checkSession(): Promise<boolean>;
}
```

## VehicleManager [#vehiclemanager]

```typescript
interface VehicleManager {
  getList(): Promise<Vehicle[]>;
  getDetail(vehicleId: string): Promise<VehicleDetail>;
  bind(vin: string, ownerCode: string): Promise<void>;
}
```

# 功能需求 (/docs/prd/functional-reqs)





# 功能需求 [#功能需求]

## F-001: 用户认证 [#f-001-用户认证]

<Callout type="info">
  优先级: P0 | 状态: 已确认
</Callout>

**功能描述：** 用户通过手机号或邮箱注册/登录系统。

**前置条件：** 用户拥有有效的手机号或邮箱地址。

**后置条件：** 用户获得有效的访问令牌。

**正常流程：**

1. 用户输入手机号/邮箱
2. 系统发送验证码
3. 用户输入验证码
4. 系统验证并返回令牌

**异常流程：**

* 验证码错误超过 5 次，锁定 30 分钟
* 网络异常时提示重试

## F-002: 车辆绑定 [#f-002-车辆绑定]

<Callout type="warn">
  优先级: P0 | 状态: 开发中
</Callout>

**功能描述：** 用户通过 VIN 码或扫码绑定车辆。

**业务规则：**

* 一个用户最多绑定 5 辆车
* 一辆车最多同时被 3 个用户绑定
* 绑定需要车主授权

## F-003: 数据同步 [#f-003-数据同步]

**功能描述：** 车辆数据与云端实时同步。

**技术规格：**

| 参数   | 值                    |
| ---- | -------------------- |
| 同步协议 | MQTT over WebSocket  |
| 数据格式 | Protocol Buffers     |
| 同步频率 | 5 秒 (状态) / 1 分钟 (位置) |
| 离线缓存 | 7 天                  |


# 产品需求总览 (/docs/prd)





# 产品需求总览 [#产品需求总览]

本文档定义了智能车联系统的产品需求，涵盖核心功能、用户故事和验收标准。

<Callout type="info">
  本文档适用于产品经理、开发工程师和测试人员。
</Callout>

## 核心功能模块 [#核心功能模块]

<Cards>
  <Card title="车辆状态监控" description="实时获取车辆位置、速度、电量等状态信息" />

  <Card title="远程控制" description="远程锁车、空调控制、充电管理等" />

  <Card title="导航服务" description="实时路况、路线规划、POI 搜索" />

  <Card title="安全告警" description="碰撞预警、偏离预警、异常告警" />
</Cards>

## 需求优先级 [#需求优先级]

| 优先级 | 功能       | 预计工时 |
| --- | -------- | ---- |
| P0  | 车辆状态实时上报 | 2 周  |
| P1  | 远程锁车/解锁  | 1 周  |
| P2  | 历史轨迹查询   | 2 周  |
| P3  | 智能充电推荐   | 3 周  |

## 用户场景 [#用户场景]

<Accordions>
  <Accordion title="场景一：车主远程查看车辆状态">
    1. 用户打开 App → 2. 首页展示车辆状态卡片 → 3. 实时更新电量、里程、位置信息 → 4. 异常时推送通知
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="场景二：远程控制车辆">
    1. 用户点击"锁车"按钮 → 2. 验证身份 → 3. 发送指令到车机 → 4. 车机执行并反馈结果 → 5. App 显示执行结果
  </Accordion>
</Accordions>

## 开发流程 [#开发流程]

<Steps>
  <Step title="需求评审">
    产品经理组织需求评审会，确认需求范围
  </Step>

  <Step title="技术方案">
    架构师输出技术方案设计文档
  </Step>

  <Step title="开发实现">
    开发团队按迭代计划实现功能
  </Step>

  <Step title="测试验收">
    QA 团队执行测试用例并验收
  </Step>
</Steps>


# 用户故事 (/docs/prd/user-stories)





# 用户故事 [#用户故事]

## 用户角色 [#用户角色]

| 角色  | 描述                  |
| --- | ------------------- |
| 车主  | 拥有车辆并可以通过 App 管理的用户 |
| 乘客  | 通过共享授权使用车辆服务的用户     |
| 管理员 | 管理车辆权限和服务的后台用户      |

## 用户故事列表 [#用户故事列表]

<Accordions>
  <Accordion title="US-001: 实时查看车辆状态">
    **作为** 车主\
    **我希望** 能够实时查看车辆的电量、里程和位置\
    **以便** 随时了解车辆状况

    **验收标准：**

    * 首页展示车辆状态卡片
    * 数据刷新频率 ≤ 5 秒
    * 离线车辆显示最后在线时间
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="US-002: 远程锁车">
    **作为** 车主\
    **我希望** 能够通过 App 远程锁车/解锁\
    **以便** 忘记锁车时无需返回车辆

    **验收标准：**

    * 执行结果在 10 秒内反馈
    * 失败时提供原因
    * 有防误触确认机制
  </Accordion>
</Accordions>

# Android SDK Quickstart (/en/docs/android-sdk/quickstart)





# Quickstart [#quickstart]

## Initialize the SDK [#initialize-the-sdk]

<Steps>
  <Step title="Add Dependency">
    Add the SDK dependency to `build.gradle.kts`.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Initialize">
    ```kotlin
    class MyApplication : Application() {
        override fun onCreate() {
            super.onCreate()
            IVCSdk.init(
                context = this,
                config = SDKConfig(
                    clientId = "your_client_id",
                    environment = Environment.STAGING
                )
            )
        }
    }
    ```
  </Step>

  <Step title="Login">
    ```kotlin
    lifecycleScope.launch {
        val result = IVCSdk.auth().login(phone = "13800138000")
        when (result) {
            is Result.Success -> {
                // Login successful
            }
            is Result.Error -> {
                // Handle error
            }
        }
    }
    ```
  </Step>
</Steps>


# Data Flow Design (/en/docs/architecture/data-flow)





# Data Flow Design [#data-flow-design]

## Core Data Flow [#core-data-flow]

### Vehicle Status Reporting [#vehicle-status-reporting]

<Mermaid
  chart="flowchart LR
    VC[Vehicle CAN Bus] -->|Collect| DAU[Data Acquisition Unit]
    DAU -->|MQTT| MQ[Message Queue]
    MQ -->|Consume| SP[Stream Processing]
    SP -->|Write| TS[(Time Series Database)]
    TS -->|Query| API[REST API]
    API -->|WebSocket| APP[Mobile App]"
/>

## Data Structures [#data-structures]

<Callout type="info">
  All timestamps use UTC time with millisecond precision.
</Callout>

### VehicleStatus [#vehiclestatus]

| Field          | Type     | Description                |
| -------------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| vehicle\_id    | string   | Vehicle VIN                |
| timestamp      | int64    | Data collection timestamp  |
| battery\_level | float    | Battery percentage (0-100) |
| speed          | float    | Speed (km/h)               |
| location       | GeoPoint | GPS coordinates            |
| engine\_status | enum     | Engine status              |


# Architecture Overview (/en/docs/architecture)





# Architecture Overview [#architecture-overview]

<Callout type="info">
  This document describes the overall architecture design of the Intelligent Connected Vehicle System.
</Callout>

## System Layers [#system-layers]

<Mermaid
  chart="graph TD
    A[Mobile App] --> B[API Gateway]
    B --> C[Microservice Cluster]
    C --> D[(Database)]
    C --> E[Message Queue]
    E --> F[Vehicle System]
    B --> G[Third-party Services]"
/>

## Technology Stack [#technology-stack]

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="app" title="Mobile">
    * Architecture: MVVM + Clean Architecture
    * Network: Retrofit / URLSession
    * State Management: StateFlow / Combine
    * Local Storage: Room / CoreData
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="backend" title="Backend">
    * Framework: Spring Boot / Go
    * API Protocol: REST + gRPC
    * Database: PostgreSQL + Redis
    * Message Queue: Kafka
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="vehicle" title="Vehicle System">
    * OS: Android Automotive / Linux
    * Communication: MQTT + CAN Bus
    * OTA: A/B Partition Update
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Project Structure [#project-structure]

<Files>
  <Folder name="src">
    <Folder name="app">
      <File name="presentation" />

      <File name="domain" />

      <File name="data" />
    </Folder>

    <Folder name="shared">
      <File name="network" />

      <File name="storage" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>


# System Overview (/en/docs/architecture/system-overview)



# System Overview [#system-overview]

## System Boundaries [#system-boundaries]

The Intelligent Connected Vehicle System consists of the following core subsystems:

1. **Cloud Platform** — Core business logic and data storage
2. **Mobile App** — User interaction interface
3. **Vehicle System** — Vehicle data collection and control execution
4. **Admin Console** — Operations and data analytics

## Communication Architecture [#communication-architecture]

<Mermaid
  chart="sequenceDiagram
    participant App as Mobile App
    participant GW as API Gateway
    participant MS as Microservices
    participant MQ as Message Queue
    participant VC as Vehicle

    App->>GW: HTTPS/WSS Request
    GW->>MS: Route Forwarding
    MS->>MQ: Push Command
    MQ->>VC: MQTT Push
    VC-->>MQ: Execution Result
    MQ-->>MS: Message Callback
    MS-->>GW: Response
    GW-->>App: Request Result"
/>

## Deployment Architecture [#deployment-architecture]

| Component     | Deployment          | Specification |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ------------- |
| API Gateway   | K8s (Multi-replica) | 4C8G x 3      |
| Microservices | K8s (Auto-scaling)  | 2C4G x 5      |
| PostgreSQL    | Cloud RDS           | Master-Slave  |
| Redis         | Cloud Redis         | Cluster Mode  |
| Kafka         | Cloud Kafka         | 3 Brokers     |


# Authentication (/en/docs/cloud-api/authentication)





# Authentication [#authentication]

## OAuth 2.0 Flow [#oauth-20-flow]

<Mermaid
  chart="sequenceDiagram
    participant App as Mobile App
    participant Auth as Auth Service
    participant API as API Gateway

    App->>Auth: 1. Authorization Request (client_id + scope)
    Auth->>Auth: 2. User Authentication
    Auth-->>App: 3. Authorization Code
    App->>Auth: 4. Exchange Token
    Auth-->>App: 5. Access Token + Refresh Token
    App->>API: 6. API Request (Bearer Token)
    API->>Auth: 7. Token Validation
    Auth-->>API: 8. User Info
    API-->>App: 9. Response"
/>

## Token Format [#token-format]

Uses JWT (JSON Web Token) with the following claims:

```json
{
  "sub": "user_123456",
  "aud": "ivc-system",
  "exp": 1719000000,
  "iat": 1718913600,
  "scope": "vehicle:read vehicle:write"
}
```

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="header" title="Request Header">
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="error" title="Error Response">
    ```json
    {
      "error": "UNAUTHORIZED",
      "message": "Token has expired",
      "status": 401
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>


# API Endpoints (/en/docs/cloud-api/endpoints)



# API Endpoints [#api-endpoints]

## Vehicle Status [#vehicle-status]

### Get Vehicle List [#get-vehicle-list]

`GET /vehicles`

**Request Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                      |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| page      | int    | No       | Page number, default 1           |
| limit     | int    | No       | Items per page, default 20       |
| status    | string | No       | Filter by status: online/offline |

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "v_001",
      "vin": "LSVAU2A38N2100001",
      "plate": "YueB·88888",
      "status": "online",
      "last_updated": "2026-07-26T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 20
}
```

### Get Vehicle Status [#get-vehicle-status]

`GET /vehicles/{id}/status`

**Response Example:**

```json
{
  "vehicle_id": "v_001",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-26T10:00:00Z",
  "battery": {
    "level": 85.5,
    "charging": true
  },
  "location": {
    "latitude": 22.5431,
    "longitude": 114.0579
  },
  "speed": 0,
  "engine": "off"
}
```


# Cloud API Overview (/en/docs/cloud-api)





# Cloud API Overview [#cloud-api-overview]

<Callout type="info">
  All APIs require Bearer Token authentication.
  Base URL: `https://api.ivc-system.com/v1`
</Callout>

## API List [#api-list]

### Vehicle Management [#vehicle-management]

| Method | Path                    | Description        |
| ------ | ----------------------- | ------------------ |
| GET    | `/vehicles`             | Get vehicle list   |
| POST   | `/vehicles/bind`        | Bind vehicle       |
| DELETE | `/vehicles/{id}`        | Unbind vehicle     |
| GET    | `/vehicles/{id}/status` | Get vehicle status |

### Remote Control [#remote-control]

| Method | Path                     | Description     |
| ------ | ------------------------ | --------------- |
| POST   | `/vehicles/{id}/lock`    | Remote lock     |
| POST   | `/vehicles/{id}/unlock`  | Remote unlock   |
| POST   | `/vehicles/{id}/climate` | Climate control |

## Error Codes [#error-codes]

| Status Code | Error Code    | Description           |
| ----------- | ------------- | --------------------- |
| 401         | UNAUTHORIZED  | Authentication failed |
| 403         | FORBIDDEN     | No permission         |
| 404         | NOT\_FOUND    | Resource not found    |
| 429         | RATE\_LIMITED | Rate limit exceeded   |


# Functional Specification (/en/docs/frs)



# Functional Specification [#functional-specification]

## Feature List [#feature-list]

| Module              | Feature                                       | Priority |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| User Management     | Registration, Login, Permission Management    | P0       |
| Vehicle Management  | Bind, Unbind, Status Query                    | P0       |
| Remote Control      | Lock, Climate, Charging                       | P1       |
| Navigation Services | Route Planning, Real-time Traffic             | P1       |
| Data Analytics      | Mileage, Energy Consumption, Driving Behavior | P2       |


# Interface Definition (/en/docs/frs/interface-def)





# Interface Definition [#interface-definition]

## Internal Interfaces [#internal-interfaces]

### App → Cloud [#app--cloud]

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="rest" title="REST API">
    Protocol: HTTPS\
    Format: JSON\
    Authentication: Bearer Token\
    Base URL: `https://api.ivc-system.com/v1`
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="ws" title="WebSocket">
    Protocol: WSS\
    Purpose: Real-time status push\
    Heartbeat: 30 seconds\
    Reconnect: Exponential backoff
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

### Cloud → Vehicle [#cloud--vehicle]

| Protocol | Purpose          | QoS   |
| -------- | ---------------- | ----- |
| MQTT     | Command delivery | QoS 1 |
| MQTT     | Status reporting | QoS 0 |

## API Specifications [#api-specifications]

### Common Response Format [#common-response-format]

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "success",
  "data": {},
  "request_id": "req_xxxxx"
}
```

### Pagination Parameters [#pagination-parameters]

| Parameter | Type   | Default | Description    |
| --------- | ------ | ------- | -------------- |
| page      | int    | 1       | Page number    |
| limit     | int    | 20      | Items per page |
| sort      | string | -       | Sort field     |
| order     | string | asc     | Sort direction |


# Module List (/en/docs/frs/module-list)





# Module List [#module-list]

## Core Modules [#core-modules]

### User Management Module [#user-management-module]

| Function              | Input                                       | Output                   |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Registration          | Phone number, verification code             | User ID                  |
| Login                 | Phone number + password / verification code | Access Token             |
| Permission Management | User ID, role                               | Permission configuration |

### Vehicle Management Module [#vehicle-management-module]

| Function       | Input                         | Output                |
| -------------- | ----------------------------- | --------------------- |
| Bind Vehicle   | VIN, owner authorization code | Binding record        |
| Unbind Vehicle | Vehicle ID                    | Unbind confirmation   |
| Status Query   | Vehicle ID                    | Real-time status data |

### Remote Control Module [#remote-control-module]

* Lock / Unlock
* Climate control on/off and temperature setting
* Charging management (start / stop / schedule)
* Window control
* Find my car

# Harmony SDK Quickstart (/en/docs/harmony-sdk/quickstart)



# Quickstart [#quickstart]

## 1. Install [#1-install]

```bash
ohpm install @ivc/sdk
```

## 2. Initialize [#2-initialize]

```typescript
// entry/src/main/ets/entryability/EntryAbility.ets
import { IVCSDK, Environment } from '@ivc/sdk';

export default class EntryAbility extends UIAbility {
  onCreate() {
    IVCSDK.init({
      clientId: 'your_client_id',
      environment: Environment.STAGING,
    });
  }
}
```

## 3. Login [#3-login]

```typescript
import { IVCSDK } from '@ivc/sdk';

async function login() {
  const result = await IVCSDK.auth().login('13800138000');
  if (result.isSuccess) {
    console.info('Login successful');
  }
}
```


# iOS SDK API Reference (/en/docs/ios-sdk/api-reference)



# API Reference [#api-reference]

## IVCSDK [#ivcsdk]

```swift
class IVCSDK {
    static func configure(clientId: String, environment: Environment)
    static func auth() -> AuthManager
    static func vehicle() -> VehicleManager
    static func control() -> ControlManager
}
```

## AuthManager [#authmanager]

```swift
class AuthManager {
    func login(phone: String) async throws -> Result<UserSession, IVCError>
    func logout() async throws
    func refreshToken() async throws
}
```

## VehicleManager [#vehiclemanager]

```swift
class VehicleManager {
    func getVehicles() -> AsyncThrowingStream<[Vehicle], Error>
    func bind(vin: String) async throws -> Vehicle
    func unbind(vehicleId: String) async throws
}
```

## ControlManager [#controlmanager]

```swift
class ControlManager {
    func lock(vehicleId: String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<ControlResult, Error>
    func unlock(vehicleId: String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<ControlResult, Error>
    func setClimate(vehicleId: String, temperature: Double) -> AsyncThrowingStream<ControlResult, Error>
}
```

# iOS SDK Quickstart (/en/docs/ios-sdk/quickstart)



# Quickstart [#quickstart]

## 1. Install the SDK [#1-install-the-sdk]

Install via Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods.

## 2. Initialize [#2-initialize]

```swift
// AppDelegate.swift
import IVCSDK

@main
class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    func application(_: UIApplication, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions _: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool {
        IVCSDK.configure(clientId: "your_client_id", environment: .staging)
        return true
    }
}
```

## 3. Login [#3-login]

```swift
Task {
    let result = try await IVCSDK.auth().login(phone: "13800138000")
    switch result {
    case .success(let session):
        print("Login successful: \(session.userId)")
    case .failure(let error):
        print("Login failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
    }
}
```

```json
    }
  }
}
```

## Initialization [#initialization]

```javascript
import { IVCSDK } from 'ivc-weapp-sdk';

// app.js
App({
  onLaunch() {
    IVCSDK.init({
      clientId: 'your_client_id',
      env: 'staging',
    });
  },
});
```


# WeChat SDK Quickstart (/en/docs/wechat-sdk/quickstart)



# Quickstart [#quickstart]

## 1. Install [#1-install]

```bash
npm install ivc-weapp-sdk
```

## 2. Initialize [#2-initialize]

```javascript
// app.js
import { IVCSDK } from 'ivc-weapp-sdk';

App({
  onLaunch() {
    IVCSDK.init({ clientId: 'your_client_id', env: 'staging' });
  },
});
```

## 3. Get Vehicle Status [#3-get-vehicle-status]

```javascript
import { IVCSDK } from 'ivc-weapp-sdk';

Page({
  async onLoad() {
    const vehicles = await IVCSDK.vehicle().getList();
    this.setData({ vehicles });
  },
});
```


# Functional Requirements (/en/docs/prd/functional-reqs)





# Functional Requirements [#functional-requirements]

## F-001: User Authentication [#f-001-user-authentication]

<Callout type="info">
  Priority: P0 | Status: Confirmed
</Callout>

**Description:** Users register or log in to the system using a phone number or email.

**Preconditions:** User has a valid phone number or email address.

**Postconditions:** User obtains a valid access token.

**Normal Flow:**

1. User enters phone number / email
2. System sends a verification code
3. User enters the verification code
4. System validates and returns a token

**Exception Flow:**

* Verification code error exceeds 5 attempts, lockout for 30 minutes
* Network error prompts user to retry

## F-002: Vehicle Binding [#f-002-vehicle-binding]

<Callout type="warn">
  Priority: P0 | Status: In Development
</Callout>

**Description:** Users bind a vehicle via VIN code or QR code scanning.

**Business Rules:**

* A user can bind up to 5 vehicles
* A vehicle can be bound by up to 3 users simultaneously
* Binding requires owner authorization

## F-003: Data Synchronization [#f-003-data-synchronization]

**Description:** Real-time data synchronization between vehicle and cloud.

**Technical Specifications:**

| Parameter      | Value                                    |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Sync Protocol  | MQTT over WebSocket                      |
| Data Format    | Protocol Buffers                         |
| Sync Frequency | 5 seconds (status) / 1 minute (location) |
| Offline Cache  | 7 days                                   |


# Product Requirements Overview (/en/docs/prd)





# Product Requirements Overview [#product-requirements-overview]

This document defines the product requirements for the Intelligent Connected Vehicle System, covering core features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

<Callout type="info">
  This document is intended for product managers, development engineers, and QA testers.
</Callout>

## Core Feature Modules [#core-feature-modules]

<Cards>
  <Card title="Vehicle Status Monitoring" description="Real-time access to vehicle location, speed, battery level, and other status information" />

  <Card title="Remote Control" description="Remote lock/unlock, climate control, charging management, etc." />

  <Card title="Navigation Services" description="Real-time traffic, route planning, POI search" />

  <Card title="Safety Alerts" description="Collision warning, lane departure warning, anomaly alerts" />
</Cards>

## Requirements Priority [#requirements-priority]

| Priority | Feature                            | Estimated Effort |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| P0       | Real-time vehicle status reporting | 2 weeks          |
| P1       | Remote lock/unlock                 | 1 week           |
| P2       | Historical trajectory query        | 2 weeks          |
| P3       | Smart charging recommendation      | 3 weeks          |

## User Scenarios [#user-scenarios]

<Accordions>
  <Accordion title="Scenario 1: Owner Remotely Checks Vehicle Status">
    1. User opens App → 2. Home page displays vehicle status card → 3. Real-time updates for battery, mileage, location → 4. Push notification on anomaly
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Scenario 2: Remote Vehicle Control">
    1. User taps "Lock" button → 2. Identity verification → 3. Command sent to vehicle → 4. Vehicle executes and reports result → 5. App displays execution result
  </Accordion>
</Accordions>

## Development Process [#development-process]

<Steps>
  <Step title="Requirements Review">
    Product manager organizes a requirements review meeting to confirm the scope
  </Step>

  <Step title="Technical Proposal">
    Architect delivers technical design document
  </Step>

  <Step title="Development & Implementation">
    Development team implements features per iteration plan
  </Step>

  <Step title="Testing & Acceptance">
    QA team executes test cases and verifies acceptance
  </Step>
</Steps>


# User Stories (/en/docs/prd/user-stories)





# User Stories [#user-stories]

## User Roles [#user-roles]

| Role      | Description                                                     |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Owner     | Vehicle owner who can manage the vehicle via the App            |
| Passenger | User who accesses vehicle services through shared authorization |
| Admin     | Backend user who manages vehicle permissions and services       |

## User Stories [#user-stories-1]

<Accordions>
  <Accordion title="US-001: Real-time Vehicle Status">
    **As** a vehicle owner\
    **I want** to view the vehicle's battery level, mileage, and location in real time\
    **So that** I can stay informed about the vehicle's condition

    **Acceptance Criteria:**

    * Vehicle status card displayed on home page
    * Data refresh interval ≤ 5 seconds
    * Offline vehicles show last online time
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="US-002: Remote Lock/Unlock">
    **As** a vehicle owner\
    **I want** to lock/unlock the vehicle remotely via the App\
    **So that** I don't need to return to the vehicle if I forget to lock it

    **Acceptance Criteria:**

    * Execution result feedback within 10 seconds
    * Failure reason provided on error
    * Anti-misoperation confirmation mechanism in place
  </Accordion>
</Accordions>
